title: Add RAG agent templates and tool-calling quickstarts; docs site updates
author: Priya Menon
description:
This PR adds a set of RAG agent templates and new tool-calling quickstarts for Python and TypeScript, and updates the docs site nav and examples index. Motivation: make it easier for engineers to get started with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) + agent patterns using Redwood's tool-calling primitives and the agent runtime. The changes include opinionated templates (search-backed QA, multi-tool orchestration, extraction + action), step-by-step quickstarts, and a lightweight example app in redwood-examples. Checklist: - [x] add RAG agent templates (yaml + README) - [x] add Python quickstart (examples/rag_agent_quickstart_py) - [x] add TypeScript quickstart (examples/rag_agent_quickstart_ts) - [x] update docs site: /docs/agents/ and /docs/quickstarts/ - [x] add minimal CI smoke tests for quickstarts - [x] run spellcheck and style lint - [ ] add extended integration tests (follow-up)

Notes and constraints: - Templates are intentionally minimal (examples are pinned to small demo datasets) to keep the quickstarts fast on CI and local machines. - Tool-calling examples demonstrate: (1) one-shot search -> call search tool, (2) multi-tool routing (browser + calendar stub), and (3) action extraction example that returns structured JSON for downstream systems. - This PR touches docs, examples, and a small runtime shim to wire the agent helper utilities into the examples repo. Related: ENG-8123 (agent Templates epic), DOC-298 (quickstarts backlog).

testing_instructions: To run the quickstart locally: 1) cd examples/rag-agent/py && python -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt ; 2) set REDWOOD_API_KEY and run python main.py (README contains env var examples). TS quickstart: cd examples/rag-agent/ts && npm i && npm run demo. Quickstart-smoke GH action simulates the same flow with a tiny demo dataset.
